The present writ petition has been filed for following reliefs:-
Anil Kumar Sharma vs The State Of Jharkhand on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27190132/
1 "For issuance of an appropriate direction (s) / order(s)/ in the nature of mandamus commanding upon the respondent concerned / prosecuting agency to defreeze of bank account of father of petitioner namely -Amar Nath Sharma, Account No.
03170100004754 Uco Bank, Mango Branch, Jamshedpur; and also for defreeze of his (petitioner) bank account S.B.I., Mango Branch, vide Account No. 32686448681; so that petitioner may repay loan amount of Rs. 10 Lakh to respondent no.2, in connection with Cyber Crime Jamshedpur P.S. Case No. 07/2020, registered for offence under section 420, 467, 468 & 471 of IPC and section 66 (C) (D) of IT Act,
2000; and now the case is pending before the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II, Jamshedpur.
AND

entities.text: Anil Kumar Sharma vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: For quashing of entire criminal proceeding against the petitioner in connection with Jamshedpur Cyber Crime P.S. Case No. 7/2020 after repay of loan amount of Rs. 10 Lakh by the petitioner to respondent no.-2 who is informant of the case, since matter relates to money dispute.
AND/OR For issuance of any other appropriate writ(s)/ order(s)/direction(s) as Your Lordships may deem fit and proper under the facts and circumstances of the case.

AND/OR For setting aside the order dated 23.01.2021 (Annexure-3/1 of the writ petition), passed in Misc. Cri. App. No.243/2021, passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge-II, Jamshedur, whereby and whereunder the petitioner filed by the petitioner for direction upon the Investigating Officer or Manager of both bank to defreezing of Bank Account, so that petitioner may pay loan amount to Informant."

2. The order dated 13.03.2024 reads as under:-
"1. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the parties that there is chance of settlement of the dispute between the parties.
3.
In view of the above submission, the matter is referred to JHALSA, Ranchi with the consent of the parties to be mediated.
4. Both the parties are directed to appear before the Secretary, JHALSA, Ranchi on 21.03.2024.
The Secretary, JHALSA, Ranchi will try to explore the possibility of settlement of the dispute.
5. After mediation process, the Secretary, JHALSA, Ranchi will submit a report in this regard.

6. List this case on 16.04.2024.

entities.text: Jamshedpur Cyber Crime P.S. Case No. 07 of 2020
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It appears that the mediation was successful.

Arrangement between the parties has been noted down by the JHALSA which is as follows:-
"Memo of Agreement in WP(Cr) No.54 of 2023 Anil Kumar Sharma .....................
Petitioner Vrs The State of Jharkhand Y Others ......................
Respondents

The points of Agreement on the aforementioned case is as follows:-
 That the Petitioner has consented to return the loan amount of Rs.10,00,000/- (Ten Lakh) plus 75000 /- (Rupees Seventy-five Thousand only) to the Respondents That is Tata Capital Limited Jamshedpur.

The mode of payment will be arranged in such a manner as The UCO Bank Branch Mango, will transfer the agreed amount of Rs. 10,75,000/- from the A/C No 0317100004754, A/c holder Sri Amarnath Sharma (Father of the Petitioner) as a matter of 1st transaction as the account is unfreezed by the order of the competent authority to the account of The Tata Capital Limited A/C No Page | 2 W.P. (Cr.)
No.54 of 2023 BENEFICIARY NAME- TATA CAPITAL FINANCIAL SERVICES LIMITED ACCOUNT NO.- ZTCFPL0535000010771278 IFSC CODE- HDFC0000060 BRANCH NAME- MANEKJI WADIA, BUILDING, FORT, MUMBAI,
MAHARAHTRA BANK NAME-HDFC BANK LTD  The Respondents will make arrangements to unfreeze the A / C No.- 0317100004754 in the concerned Bank by requesting the competent Authority or Concerned Hon'ble Court of Law in writing  Both the Parties agree for the disposal of Cyber Crime P.S 07/2020 pending in the Court of ADJ II at Jamshedpur only after the realization of the settled amount of Rs.10,75,000/- (Rupees Ten Lakh Seventy-five Thousand only)
That if the account is unfreezed and payment is made, there will not be any objection to the Respondents."
4. It has further been submitted that the freezed amount after unfreezing will be directly transfer to the bank account of the victim as disclosed in the agreement itself.
Further the parties will be bound by as per agreement arrived before the JHALSA.

5. Since it is personal dispute and considering the fact that the matter has been settled outside the court, the present writ petition is hereby allowed and criminal case initiated vide Cyber Crime Jamshedpur P.S. Case No.07 of 2020 is, hereby, quashed and set aside.

6. With above observation and direction, the present writ petition stands disposed of.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Amar/-
